external_evidence_gates.U1: unverified restaurant pricing and business identity
external_evidence_gates.U3: unverified provider accounts, billing caps and consent

CON-01.source_summary: CON-01: Publish the COMMON, DTO and schema records below verbatim as live-v1. Fixture bundle has positive and negative cases keyed by contract ID, synthetic=true, schema_version=1; includes restaurant r-demo, guest g-one, item i-one, revision 0/1 and a deterministic receipt. Reject fixture mutations that remove fields or change money units. Fixtures are not runtime fallback data.

CON-02.source_summary: CON-02: CREATE live_restaurants and live_tables using DB-A below. Existing restaurant IDs remain TEXT; new live config references restaurants(id) with RESTRICT. Unconfigured rows are disabled. Hours use Asia/Kolkata, ISO weekday 1–7 and minute intervals; cross-midnight hours are represented as two day segments.

CON-03.source_summary: CON-03: CREATE DB-B live_carts, live_orders, live_receipts, live_guest_access, live_order_events, live_payment_events, live_commands. Only carts/access reference guest_sessions with CASCADE; all business history references restaurant/order with RESTRICT. Composite restaurant/order FKs prevent cross-tenant joins.

CON-04.source_summary: CON-04: DB-C memberships keyed (restaurant_id,clerk_user_id), role owner/order_staff/cashier, active, version. CLI input --restaurant-id and --clerk-user-id; command is an operator-only initial-owner action against an explicitly selected DB, returns safe restaurant/subject IDs. Repeat same association is no-op; conflicting existing owner is refused.

CON-05.source_summary: CON-05: verify_staff_token(request)->StaffPrincipal{sub:string}. Only Bearer JWT accepted on /v1/live/staff routes. Use PyJWT[crypto] for RS256 verification, configured issuer/JWKS URL/authorized parties, exp and nbf; no decoded-but-unverified claims. Missing/invalid token ->401 staff_auth_required; key-fetch outage ->503 identity_unavailable. Cache keys bounded for 5 minutes, unknown kid triggers at most one refresh.

CON-06.source_summary: CON-06: require_role(conn,principal,rid,allowed)->Membership reads active membership on each action. GET /v1/live/staff/memberships ->{memberships:[{restaurant_id,role,version}]}. Owner GET/PUT /v1/live/staff/restaurants/{rid}/members/{subject}; PUT {expected_version,role,active}->Membership. GET .../members returns {memberships:Membership[]} sorted by subject. PUT creates with expected_version=0 (201), edits require current version (200). PUT unknown subject creates only after operator-verified Clerk subject; no public self-enrollment. Last active owner cannot be deactivated/demoted (409 last_owner).

CON-07.source_summary: CON-07: /api/orderly/live/* maps only the route/method pairs in LIVE ROUTES to fixed /v1/live/*. Forward Authorization only for staff routes, guest cookie for guest routes, Idempotency-Key only for command routes. Forward only documented query keys. Existing 64 KiB cap, origin validation, timeout, no-store and no redirects remain.

CON-08.source_summary: CON-08: /staff/sign-in uses Clerk Next SDK; staff shell requests CON-06 memberships then lets user choose an allowed restaurant. useStaffSession exposes {status:loading|signed_out|ready|unavailable,token,restaurantId,role}; token is memory-only. Unknown setup shows unavailable, never the mock demo profile.

CON-09.source_summary: CON-09: owner GET/PUT /v1/live/staff/restaurants/{rid}/settings; PUT {expected_version,name,timezone:"Asia/Kolkata",hours:Hours,is_open,brand_label}->Settings. Strings 1–120 chars; brand_label max60; no uploaded assets. Ordering enabled is not editable here. Owner identity/invoice fields remain U1 gated.

CON-10.source_summary: CON-10: GET /v1/live/staff/restaurants/{rid}/menu ->Menu; owner PUT .../menu/{item_id} {expected_catalog_version,item:MenuItem}->Menu. order_staff/owner PUT .../menu/{item_id}/availability {expected_catalog_version,available:boolean}->Menu. Owner may create item with new UUID; no deletes, use available=false. Modifier price/availability follows existing ModifierGroup shape; unknown foreign item404.

CON-11.source_summary: CON-11: U1 evidence gate. Produce versioned PricingProfile and receipt identity examples from the named restaurant/accountant: INR, minor-unit rounding, tax inclusion/basis, charges, required identity/receipt fields and worked examples. Synthetic profile uses no tax/fees and is labeled synthetic, never a production default. If real policy exceeds this plan, return a contract change before pricing implementation for live use.

CON-12.source_summary: CON-12: owner GET/PUT /v1/live/staff/restaurants/{rid}/tables/{table_id}; PUT {expected_version,label,active}->Table. GET .../tables returns {tables:Table[]} sorted by label then ID. PUT creates UUID with expected_version=0 (201); existing table requires current version (200). Customer link /r/{rid}?table={table_id}; server validates active table at quote and checkout. IDs are UUID, label1–30 chars. URL may be encoded by native/downloadable link; a QR image is optional presentation, not auth.

CON-13.source_summary: CON-13: public GET /v1/live/restaurants/{rid}/menu ->{schema_version:1,restaurant:PublicRestaurant,catalog_version,items:MenuItem[]}. PublicRestaurant includes id,name,brand_label,is_open,ordering_enabled,timezone; no credentials/memberships/contacts. Only configured live restaurants or isolated demo scope resolve. Ordering-hours result is server-derived.

CON-14.source_summary: CON-14: verified guest GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/live/restaurants/{rid}/cart. PUT {expected_revision,items:CartItemInput[]} ->Cart; DELETE {expected_revision}->empty Cart. <=50 lines, quantity1–10, notes<=500, exactly rid on all lines; server canonical labels/prices. Foreign or invalid item422 catalog_invalid. Stale revision409 cart_conflict includes current cart.

CON-15.source_summary: CON-15: POST /v1/live/restaurants/{rid}/quote {expected_revision,fulfillment:"dine_in"|"takeaway",table_id:UUID|null,promotion_code:string|null}->Quote. Quote includes cart_revision,catalog_version,pricing_version,offer_version nullable,quote_digest,receipt_preview and totals. Fulfillment requires active table only for dine_in; takeaway table=null. No address/tip/online-payment fields. Unverified real profile503 pricing_unconfigured.

CON-16.source_summary: CON-16: DB-D promotions; owner GET/PUT /v1/live/staff/restaurants/{rid}/offers/{id}. PUT {expected_version,code,starts_at,ends_at,min_subtotal_minor,percent_bps,max_discount_minor,max_redemptions,active}->Offer. GET .../offers returns {offers:Offer[]} sorted by starts_at descending then ID; bounded to 100 with opaque next_cursor or null and limit1–100 default50. PUT creates with expected_version=0 (201), edits require current version (200). Code normalized uppercase ASCII [A-Z0-9-]{3,32}; percent1–10000 basis points; dates UTC start<end; positive cap and max_redemptions. One rule per restaurant/code; public transferable code.

CON-17.source_summary: CON-17: quote accepts at most one code. Discount=min(floor(subtotal_minor*percent_bps/10000),max_discount_minor,subtotal_minor), then CON-11 tax policy determines tax basis. Quote does not reserve redemption. Invalid/expired/exhausted code409 offer_unavailable; preserve basket and show explicit removal/requote. Code normalization matches CON-16.

CON-18.source_summary: CON-18: POST /v1/live/restaurants/{rid}/orders + UUID Idempotency-Key; body {expected_revision,quote_digest,fulfillment,table_id,promotion_code}. First201/replay200 ->LiveOrderReceipt; same key changed body409 idempotency_conflict. Lock guest, live cart, restaurant config and offer in fixed order; replay before cleared-cart validation. Commit receipt, Submitted state/event, guest access, offer allocation, replay response and cart clear together.

CON-19.source_summary: CON-19: guest GET /v1/live/restaurants/{rid}/orders/{oid}-> {receipt:LiveOrderReceipt,operation:OrderState,payment:PaymentState}. GET .../orders?limit=25&cursor=... ->{orders:[...],next_cursor:null|string}. Limit1–50, opaque cursor bounded512 chars scoped to rid/guest, sort(created_at,id) descending. Missing/foreign/revoked404 not_found. Guest reset cannot retrieve a previous receipt; operator business history remains.

CON-20.source_summary: CON-20: staff GET /v1/live/staff/restaurants/{rid}/orders?view=active|all|settlement&limit=25&cursor=... ->{orders:OrderSummary[],next_cursor,as_of:UTC}; GET .../orders/{oid}->OrderDetail. All roles may read; owner/order_staff see full operational detail; cashier sees payment-relevant snapshot. Active=Submitted/Accepted/Preparing/Ready only; completed-unpaid remains visible under all/settlement.

CON-21.source_summary: CON-21: owner/order_staff POST .../orders/{oid}/transitions +Idempotency-Key {expected_version,target,reason:null|string}->OrderDetail. Submitted->Accepted or Rejected; Accepted->Preparing; Preparing->Ready; Ready->Completed; Accepted/Preparing/Ready->Cancelled with reason1–500. Terminal states immutable; replay precedes version check. cashier403. Payment status never changed by transition.

CON-22.source_summary: CON-22: cashier/owner POST .../orders/{oid}/payments +Idempotency-Key {expected_version,method:"cash"|"upi"|"card"|"other"}->OrderDetail. Amount/currency come exclusively from immutable receipt; full amount only. Can record for Accepted/Preparing/Ready/Completed, never Submitted/Rejected/Cancelled. Existing active payment409 already_paid. This records staff assertion, not bank confirmation.

CON-23.source_summary: CON-23: owner POST .../orders/{oid}/payment-reversals +Idempotency-Key {expected_version,payment_event_id,reason:string1–500}->OrderDetail. Append one full reversal referencing active recorded payment; no event deletion or external refund. Payment becomes unpaid; settlement_required=false after recording refund/correction reason. Reversed reference409 already_reversed.

CON-24.source_summary: CON-24: DB-E contacts/consent_events/suppressions. Per-restaurant normalized email/phone is unique; channel-specific affirmative consent carries source,capture_time,notice_version,evidence_ref. A contact is not consent. Store personal destination only in DB; no logs/fixtures with real contacts. New contact defaults ineligible.

CON-25.source_summary: CON-25: verified guest POST /v1/live/restaurants/{rid}/consents {order_id,channel:"sms"|"email",destination,notice_version,consent:true}-> {recorded:true}. Require guest access to order; each channel explicit unchecked checkbox and separate request after order. False/absent consent creates no opt-in. Approved notice version and proof policy under U3 before real capture; synthetic tests use fixture notice.

CON-26.source_summary: CON-26: GET /v1/live/unsubscribe/{token} shows confirmation only; POST same route idempotently suppresses token-bound restaurant/contact/channel, returns {unsubscribed:true}. Token 32 random bytes base64url, only hash stored, no contact in URL. POST can arrive without guest/staff auth; token is narrowly scoped capability. Invalid token404, rate bound same-origin UI path; verified provider unsubscribes may also create suppression.

CON-27.source_summary: CON-27: DB-F campaigns, approvals, deliveries, delivery_events and provider_configs. Approval snapshot stores frozen recipients/message/channel/offer version/budget; recipient work unique(approval_id,contact_id). Durable states queued/claimed/accepted/uncertain/delivered/failed/suppressed. Reservation and accepted cost totals never exceed frozen max under worker locks.

CON-28.source_summary: CON-28: owner GET/POST .../campaigns and GET/PUT .../campaigns/{cid}. POST {channel,offer_id,message,subject:null|string}->Campaign status draft; PUT adds expected_version. message1–1000 chars, email subject1–150, SMS subject=null. Audience v1 is all currently eligible restaurant contacts for selected channel; no CSV import or aggregator lists. Edit increments version, invalidates any non-dispatched approval and suppresses unsent old work; accepted work remains historical.

CON-29.source_summary: CON-29: POST .../campaigns/{cid}/preview {expected_version}->Preview{preview_id,expires_at,recipient_count,estimated_cost_minor,currency:"INR",content_digest,offer_version,setup_ready}; POST .../approve +Idempotency-Key {expected_version,preview_id,max_cost_minor}->Approval. Preview expires after10min. Freeze distinct eligible contact IDs, channel, text, subject, offer version and conservative per-recipient cost bounds; never accept a client-supplied recipient list.

CON-30.source_summary: CON-30: owner GET .../messaging-setup ->{sms:SetupState,email:SetupState}; SetupState {configured,verified,reason_codes,cost_version}. Operator loads server-only config keyed restaurant/channel with account ID, secret env alias, verified sender/template IDs, currency=INR, config_version and cost_version positive integers, max_recipient_cost_minor, max_campaign_cost_minor, max_daily_cost_minor and max_audience (all positive integers; audience<=500 initially). Daily boundary is Asia/Kolkata; accepted and uncertain reservations count toward both caps. No default live budget. No credential value accepted by browser API or returned. Setup activation evidence belongs to U3; missing/unverified config blocks sends.

CON-31.source_summary: CON-31: send_sms(config,DeliveryInput)->DeliveryResult (COMMON). HTTPS fixed MSG91 send endpoint; explicit timeout10s; no automatic HTTP retries. Template variables derive only from frozen approved text and verified DLT mapping. Include local delivery ID in documented correlation field when supported. Unknown acceptance returns uncertain. Exact vendor request/response fixture and authenticated reconciliation capability must be frozen from actual account/API before live_ready.

CON-32.source_summary: CON-32: send_email(config,DeliveryInput)->DeliveryResult. POST https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/send with Bearer server credential, one personalization/to recipient, verified from, frozen subject and text/plain content, custom_args.delivery_id; include unsubscribe URL. HTTP202 means accepted, never delivered. Timeout10s, no automatic HTTP retries; response ambiguity uncertain.

CON-33.source_summary: CON-33: claim_next(conn,now)->DeliveryInput|null. Select a due candidate without locking, then acquire live_restaurants row (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED for worker claims), daily budget row, campaign/approval, contact and delivery locks in that order; skip busy restaurant candidates and revalidate queued state. The restaurant row serializes day-row creation and cross-day reconciliation. DB-F live_daily_send_budgets and delivery budget_channel/budget_day hold the reservation identity; rules in section18.17.1 apply. All approval, pause, suppression and dispatch eligibility transactions use the same order; recheck unpaused approval/config/consent/offer and reserve maximum recipient charge before marking claimed. Batch size1; lease30s, poll2s. Recovery of expired claimed means uncertain, never queued. No network inside SQL transaction.

CON-34.source_summary: CON-34: dispatch(delivery_id,claim_token) calls exactly one channel adapter for valid lease. Persist accepted/provider ID or uncertain after network. Only explicit safely_not_sent may retry, max3 attempts with30s/120s/600s backoff; any unknown result stops retries. Retain cost reservation for accepted/uncertain; release only proven no-send. Crash after request before persistence becomes uncertain.

CON-35.source_summary: CON-35: POST /v1/live/webhooks/sendgrid/{account_alias}; verify signed raw body/timestamp with pinned account public key before JSON parse. Limit body256KiB and events100; dedupe sg_event_id within account. Map correlated accepted/delivered/bounce/dropped/spamreport/unsubscribe events; bounce/complaint/unsubscribe suppress channel. Delivery history append-only; duplicate/out-of-order event cannot resurrect suppressed eligibility.

CON-36.source_summary: CON-36: reconcile_sms(config,provider_id,delivery_id)->DeliveryResult. No unauthenticated webhook may mark delivered or release a cost reservation. U3 must supply supported authenticated status lookup or verified signed callback contract and exact fixture. Until then adapter can be tested against fixture but SMS live activation stays blocked; uncertain sends remain uncertain.

CON-37.source_summary: CON-37: owner POST .../campaigns/{cid}/pause or /resume +Idempotency-Key {expected_version}->Campaign. Resume requires still-valid approved offer/config/budget and never queues uncertain work. GET .../campaigns/{cid}/deliveries returns paginated safe status rows (no full destination). POST .../reconcile asks authenticated provider lookup only, not resend.

CON-38.source_summary: CON-38: owner GET .../summary?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD ->Summary. Range<=31 days in restaurant timezone; values integer INR minor units. Separate submitted/completed/cancelled, recorded_paid, reversed, unpaid, settlement_required and promotion_submissions; campaigns report accepted/delivered/uncertain/cost_reserved. No attribution/ROI/accounting certification claim.

CON-39.source_summary: CON-39: html data-theme=light default; optional localStorage key orderlyapp.theme.v1 admits only light/dark. Minimal pre-paint bootstrap catches property/read failures; toggle catches writes and still works in memory. Native44px button names opposite theme. Apply approved D15–D20/D28–D30 tokens; no theme dependency or account sync. Task state never remounts on theme switch.

CON-40.source_summary: CON-40: LiveShell{restaurant,role,children}; owner links Overview/Orders/Menu/Marketing/Settings below header at every width. Header contains labeled theme button, wraps in flow,44px targets. FormErrors{errors:[{field_id,message}],submitted:boolean} focuses linked summary only after explicit failed form submission, preserves fields; background errors announced without focus theft.

CON-41.source_summary: CON-41: browser live adapter explicitly maps snake_case live-v1 DTOs to camelCase types; Result<T>={ok:true,data:T}|{ok:false,error:{code,message,fields,kind:definitive|uncertain}}. Mutation network/5xx/malformed success ->uncertain. 4xx business response definitive only when server guarantees no commit; identity loss does not prove prior request failed. Fetch same-origin gateway, never provider URLs.

CON-42.source_summary: CON-42: /r/{rid}?table={id} displays menu first plus Speak your order control; dine_in/takeaway selector and Pay at restaurant. Query table is proposed context verified by backend, not auth. Catalog loading/error/empty/populated distinct. No items copy: No items are available to order right now; Check again plus ask-staff guidance; preserve existing basket/status links.

CON-43.source_summary: CON-43: one basket controller owns CON-14 state. >=64rem and menu>=22rem/summary>=18rem: read-only summary alongside menu; otherwise44px View basket · count bar with safe-area/reserved space, in-flow at constrained height. Review empty copy Your basket is empty + Browse menu. Retain unavailable rows labeled No longer available with Remove; no silent substitutions.

CON-44.source_summary: CON-44: checkout obtains CON-15/17 quote, renders receipt preview and explicit Place order · Pay at restaurant. Before POST persist {schema_version:1,restaurant_id,key,body,summary,created_at} in sessionStorage under orderlyapp.liveCheckoutRecovery.v1. Failed write blocks submit. Body/key are immutable until definitive outcome. Unknown outcome routes recovery; confirmed receipt routes status. No online payment.

CON-45.source_summary: CON-45: recovery view says We’re checking whether your order was received, shows frozen submitted summary and Check order status. That button replays CON-18 exact key/body. Confirmed receipt clears recovery and opens status; definitive no-commit returns basket review; ongoing outage remains uncertain. No automatic new attempt, no automatic polling required.

CON-46.source_summary: CON-46: status page reads CON-19 and separates Submitted/Accepted/etc from Unpaid/Paid. Refresh button obtains latest state; receipt totals fixed. MarketingConsent has separate unchecked SMS/email boxes, displayed approved notice, channel destination and explicit Save preference; consent failure never invalidates order.404 does not reveal foreign receipt.

CON-47.source_summary: CON-47: queue polls every5s while visible and authenticated; pause on hidden tab, fetch before enabling actions after resume. Last success older than15s or any read failure marks stale, shows Connection lost — orders may be out of date plus last-updated and Retry, disables mutations. First-load error is unavailable; successful empty says No active orders right now.

CON-48.source_summary: CON-48: phone queue->full-width detail with Back restoring queue position where practical. >=64rem with each pane>=22rem: same detail in split layout. All transition commands use CON-21 expected_version+UUID key. Late read for orderA ignored after selectingB. Unselected detail says Select an order to view details. No duplicated controllers.

CON-49.source_summary: CON-49: inline full receipt amount/currency plus required method, single Record payment received button. Saving label until confirmed. Owner reversal requires reason and original payment selection; settlement task visible for paid cancelled orders. Same persistent action identity as CON-48; no confirmation modal, partial amount or online payment.

CON-50.source_summary: CON-50: owner Settings presents separate forms for branding/hours, tables and verified-subject membership role. Uses CON-09/12/06; safe messaging readiness read-only via CON-30. No browser secret-entry, self-onboarding or live activation switch. Other roles get access-denied view.

CON-51.source_summary: CON-51: owner Menu edits item name/description/price/modifier rules; order_staff sees availability toggles only. Currency INR with integer minor-unit conversion, no floating stored money. One versioned save; stale response requires review. Disable modifications while snapshot stale.

CON-52.source_summary: CON-52: owner Marketing empty state No campaigns yet, primary Create campaign draft and secondary Settings. Draft fields channel, selected offer, message, email subject. Drafting works before provider setup; send controls remain gated. Plain text only; no AI auto-send, CSV audience import or delivery-platform contacts.

CON-53.source_summary: CON-53: approval view displays frozen channel/text/offer-version/count/estimated-cost/max-cost INR. Owner explicitly approves preview_id; expired/changed preview requires new review. Audience is count plus masked summaries, never editable list. Disabled send when setup/consent/budget missing. Track same approval UUID/body until resolved.

CON-54.source_summary: CON-54: campaign results separates accepted, delivered, uncertain, failed and suppressed; pause/resume/reconcile use CON-37, never retry-uncertain button. Overview uses CON-38 exact operational/payment metrics and labeled date range. Show last refresh and unavailable state; no inferred sales attribution.

CON-55.source_summary: CON-55: explicit Start/Stop listening with browser SpeechRecognition or webkit equivalent feature detection; transcript<=500 chars editable. Permission/unsupported/network/no-speech shows text fallback. Stop/unmount/restaurant change increments session generation; late results ignored. No audio upload/recording storage. Pilot locale requires U4; fixture uses explicit en-IN labeled unverified.

CON-56.source_summary: CON-56: propose(transcript,restaurantId,catalogVersion,items)->{kind:add|clarify|navigate,restaurantId,catalogVersion,itemId:null|string,quantity:1..10|null,modifiers,missingFields,transcript}. Deterministic exact normalized names/aliases from selected catalog; ambiguous same-name items clarify; unsupported multi-command clarifies. Never import mock-data or accept model-supplied prices.

CON-57.source_summary: CON-57: VoiceProposal shows editable item/quantity/modifiers and explicit Add to basket; Cancel discards only proposal. Apply consumes current cart revision through CON-14; current catalog/restaurant mismatch invalidates proposal. It cannot invoke checkout or campaign endpoints.

CON-58.source_summary: CON-58: POST /v1/live/demo/session with {} and valid guest cookie returns201 {schema_version:1,restaurant_id:string,expires_at:UTC}; server records guest ownership in live_restaurants.demo_owner_id. Existing guest cookie is the capability, never a browser role or new bearer token. Scope expires with guest session. Dedicated /v1/live/demo/restaurants/{rid} prefix mirrors only GET orders, GET orders/{oid}, POST orders/{oid}/transitions, POST orders/{oid}/payments, POST orders/{oid}/payment-reversals, GET campaigns, POST campaigns, PUT campaigns/{cid}, POST campaigns/{cid}/preview and POST campaigns/{cid}/approve with identical staff DTOs and replay rules. Demo approval creates simulated outcomes only. Other methods/paths404. Customer paths retain normal guest checks and also require synthetic owner match. Gateway allowlist and typed client add only these paths in this ticket; same-origin checks apply. New copy of synthetic fixture per session; domain scope is server-resolved demo, never client boolean. Demo role commands may mutate only that copy; network transports and live activation denied regardless request/forged IDs. Reset/delete affects only demo scope; no paid state claims outside simulation.

CON-59.source_summary: CON-59: /demo creates isolated CON-58 session and links Customer/Staff/Owner for same synthetic restaurant. Persistent Demo — no real orders, payments or messages label. Reset demo explicitly creates fresh scope; existing live browser/session cannot be converted into demo authority. Reuse real task components, do not build a second UI implementation.

CON-60.source_summary: CON-60: GET /health/live-service ->{ready,source_sha,schema_ready,worker_ready,identity_ready,live_enabled,reason_codes},503 when required enabled capability unavailable. Worker heartbeat table records last_tick and source_sha; stale>30s unhealthy for marketing. Log request/restaurant/order/delivery IDs, state transitions and safe error codes only, never contact/text/token/secrets. Live disabled default.

CON-61.source_summary: CON-61: worker process uses same backend image/modules/database, command python -m app.campaign_worker; no migrations in startup. ORDERLY_LIVE_ENABLED=0 and ORDERLY_MARKETING_SEND_ENABLED=0 defaults. Operator explicitly provisions worker only after U3 platform/cost authorization. Deploy additive schema -> API -> worker paused -> web -> synthetic smoke -> gated live enable.

CON-62.source_summary: CON-62: existing CI adds live contract fixture conformance, PostgreSQL race/rollback tests and synthetic cross-role browser journey. Provider fake transports only; no live keys/sends in CI. Required checks fail on skipped required PG tests. Keep current security/web/backend/Chromium jobs, no duplicate test framework.

CON-63.source_summary: CON-63: U2 decision artifact states per-table retention, lawful deletion/export scope, requester authorization, backup treatment and restoration re-suppression procedure. Live deletion remains disabled until approved policy and a separately reviewed implementation delta exist. Existing guest cleanup remains active only for its original/access records. No invented retention duration.

CON-64.source_summary: CON-64: evidence packet records exact source/schema, isolated DB target, backup hash, restore result, row/event/receipt hashes, consent suppression restored, uncertain claims preserved and rollback compatible version. No production fault injection. Missing backup permission/environment is blocked, not passed.

CON-65.source_summary: CON-65: U1–U4 evidence matrix names restaurant/owner, signed-off pricing/receipt, staff roles, devices/browser/locale, microphone test conditions, provider account ownership/onboarding, consented test recipients, conservative budgets/caps and support owner. Live channel tests require explicit permission before any send; no credentials or personal destinations committed.

CON-66.source_summary: CON-66: owner offer list/form uses CON-16 fields, displays public/transferable/no-stacking warning and cancellation does not restore allocation. Dates entered in restaurant timezone converted to UTC; percent displayed0.01–100.00 maps integer basis points. Inactive/expired/exhausted labels derive server state. No recipient-exclusive promise.

CON-67.source_summary: CON-67: operator CLI --input <private JSON> accepts new restaurant_id,name,cuisine,brand_label,timezone=Asia/Kolkata and Hours; create restaurants compatibility row plus live_restaurants row transactionally, ordering_enabled=false. Existing ID refused; never convert fixture catalog into live restaurant automatically. Compatibility fields rating=0,delivery_minutes="Not offered",delivery_fee_cents=0,image_emoji="",tags=[] are display placeholders, not live pricing inputs.

wire_status_note: Synthetic expected contracts only. HTTP statuses not explicitly promised by CON records require provider confirmation. No requests were sent.
